import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
native_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David"],
    "spend": [1500, 800, 1000, 500]
})

# Convert to narwhals and add tier column with conditional expression
df = nw.from_native(native_df)
df = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000)
        .then(nw.lit("gold"))
        .otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
)

# Convert back to native and display
result = nw.to_native(df)
print(result)
